fields.value: Dataset:  Deep-rooted Values Clash in Climate-related Conflicts
The Role of Religious-based and Religious-inspired Worldview Ideas in the Dutch Climate-related Conflict about Agriculture, Nature, and Nitrogen

dsDescriptionValue.value: The research project Deep-rooted Values Clash in Climate-related Conflicts investigated how the Dutch political parties CDA, ChristenUnie, SGP, GroenLinks, D66, and Partij voor de Dieren view dairy farming, nature, and nitrogen from the perspective of their party philosophy. The vision of these political parties was compared with how dairy farmers give meaning to their work. This was investigated on the basis of interviews and a desk review of policy documents and vision documents collected in the year 2022-2023. These documents are stored in this dataset.

publicationCitation.value: Hummel, T.M. van. 2025. "Deep-rooted Values Clash in Climate-Related Conflicts The Role of Religious-based and Religious-inspired Worldview Ideas in the Dutch Climate-related Conflict about Agriculture, Nature, and Nitrogen." PhD Diss. University of Groningen.
Hummel, T. van. In proceeding. "How calling and purposes interact with worldview and sensemaking in dairy farmers’ reaction to the Dutch nitrogen crisis." Culture and Organization.
Hummel, T. van. In proceeding. "De religieuze dimensie van de politieke visies op het landbouwbeleid" Tijdschrift voor Religie Recht en Beleid.
